title: Salem Tops Rankings for Top US Ghost Tour Experiences
excerpt: A new study ranking America’s best ghost tours has given top honors to Salem’s History and Hauntings of Salem Guided Walking Tour. According to a report, the team from the...
content:
According to a report, the team from the Magic Hour reviewed Tripadvisor reviews for 218 ghost tours and paranormal experiences across the country. In assigning its ranking, Magic Hour considered average ratings, the percentage of five-star reviews, and the overall volume of positive reviews. 

The History and Hauntings of Salem Guided Walking Tour scored 93.75 out of 100. The approximately two-hour tour holds a 4.9 Tripadvisor rating, with close to 95% of reviewers giving it five stars. More than 9,600 people have reviewed the tour overall, detailed travel writer Stephanie Gravalese writing for Yahoo! Creators.

According to the tour website, the tour shares stories of Salem's history alongside the ghostly lore associated with the visitor experience — this mix of history and spookiness puts it in a league of its own.

The tour's website also notes that the History and Hauntings of Salem Guided Walking Tour is ranked No. Cultural & Historic Tour in the United States and No. 2 Cultural & Historic Tour in the world by TripAdvisor.
